externalObservations.description: Candidate shared screen behind G58 chairs I7/I8
externalObservations.reason: I17/I18 registrations place G57's sofa end next to G58's chair end, with matching screen appearance. This suggests shared ownership but does not prove a calibrated seam.

notes: One pale two-seat sofa, two blue armchairs and one oval glass/brass table resolve Seat_I5–Seat_I8 and Table_I2 once. I18 identifies the sofa slots; I22 identifies the chairs. The same table is observed in both normal views.

Both wide captures show the pale paneled side wall, dark seating floor, ribbed partitions and pale aisle. The footprint includes only this bay and an immediate aisle strip; distant brown window-side chairs, plants and glazing are excluded.

The chair-side screen is provisionally referenced to G57's existing sofa screen instead of generating a second object. Its correspondence and seam need owner review; standalone G58 therefore shows only its own sofa-side screen.

The existing shared builders supply furniture and glass materials. The ribbed screen is approximated by an opaque grooved wall-panel; curved chair shells, wood supports, the glass table's lower shelf, bin and transient cups are simplified or omitted.

Live I18/I22 registration points and headings are preserved with their revision/hash. No heading was copied directly into world yaw and no global floor transform or measured room dimensions are claimed.
reviewItems: Confirm I5/I6 sofa slot order and I7/I8 wall-side/aisle-side chair correspondence.
Confirm the proposed shared screen with G57 and align the two blocks before composing; render that boundary once.
Review the next bay's ownership of G58's sofa screen, screen transparency/ribs/height and side-wall continuation.
Measure local dimensions and aisle width; the 4.2x4.2 m crop and 4.1 m ceiling are provisional visualization estimates.
Fit the map basis and block placement before adding G58 to a composed floor layout.
